reason: Round2 curriculum improves controlled development tasks but introduces severe English overexposure; natural probes show limited transfer. Seek correction using actual rendered outcome preferences instead of blindly extending identical SFT.
collection_scope: Only 60 round2 training photo groups/360 tasks/720 bilingual predictions. No development or acceptance image becomes a preference training row.
admission: Input, previously approved target, and actual model render must be directly viewed; prefer only a clear visible improvement in request completion and quality. Equal/ambiguous results excluded. Numeric inverse or L1 never automatically establishes a preference.
proposed_method: Small DPO plus chosen-response SFT anchor, with a matched chosen-only SFT control; freeze actual data and final hyperparameters after visual admission, before any training.
acceptance_policy: Round2 acceptance remains closed during diagnosis and training; final selection must be locked before any acceptance inference.
resource_limit: Same original total16 occupied GPU hours; GPUs0/2/3, protect1. Collection consumes budget; no reset.
claim_boundary: DPO source motivates a hypothesis; no evidence yet that preference optimization will make this JSON-editing policy practical.

native_natural_addition.admission: Re-review request/output for every actual natural target; no inherited reference from a rewritten task. Use training groups only, before any natural parent inference.
